描述_EN: when the metal, loop shaped handle is squeezed, the chickens peck in turn at the bowl between them. one end of the loop is attached to the bar on which the chickens sit and the other to an inner bar which slides back and forth when the loop is squeezed. this colorful toy is hand held and is operated by squeezing the metal loop below the birds.
描述_ZN: 当金属环形手柄被挤压时，小鸡就会依次啄食它们之间的碗。 环的一端连接到鸡所坐的杆上，另一端连接到一个内杆上，当环被挤压时，内杆可以来回滑动。 这个彩色的玩具是手持的，通过挤压鸟类下面的金属环来操作。
